name: How much does it cost to hire a head injury lawyer?
description: Most head injury lawyers work on a contingency fee basis, meaning they are paid a percentage of your settlement or award, with no upfront fees.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire a head injury lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most head injury lawyers work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay upfront legal fees. Instead, the lawyer's payment is a percentage of the compensation you receive from a settlement or court award. If your case is unsuccessful, you typically owe no attorney fees. This arrangement makes legal representation accessible to those who may not have immediate funds.
